title: Russia Launches 317 Drones; 276 Downed or Jammed
detail: Overnight Nov 8-9 Russia launched 317 attack drones, 105 of them jet-powered Shaheds, plus Gerbera and decoy drones and S-8000 Banderol/Dan-T cruise missiles. Air defence downed or jammed 276; hits recorded at 31 locations and debris fell at nine. Preliminary Air Force figures; no casualty details reported.

media.caption: Russia attacks Ukraine with 317 drones, 276 UAVs downed
